relationships.subject: capsaicin
relationships.evidence_quote: Quantification of the vasodilation after topical application of capsaicin or cinnamaldehyde is often implemented to indirectly assess Transient Receptor Potential (TRP) Vanilloid 1 (TRPV1) or Ankyrin 1 (TRPA1) functionality respectively.

relationships.subject: capsaicin
relationships.evidence_quote: Both doses of cinnamaldehyde and capsaicin induced a robust, dose-dependent increase in DBF.

key_findings: Topical cinnamaldehyde and capsaicin on finger skin induce robust dose-dependent dermal blood flow increases in healthy men.
The response is reproducible between hands and over time, supporting use as a vascular read-out of TRPA1/TRPV1 function in distal neuropathy.
